import json
from src.serializer import encode_user

def test_does_not_mutate_or_drop_extra_fields():
    user = {'name': 'Lin', 'active': False, 'role': 'admin'}
    before = dict(user)
    assert json.loads(encode_user(user)) == before
    assert user == before
